displayName: Catalog: the BigQuery graph export is out of date

documentation.content: No run of the daily catalog graph export (Cloud Run job catalog-graph-export, scheduled at 02:30 UTC) finished cleanly in the last 26 hours, so the catalog_os tables in BigQuery that experiments and dashboards read are older than a day. The check runs every 10 minutes. Open Cloud Run jobs, catalog-graph-export, and read the latest execution's logs (search for "graph export"); the error is also kept on the latest row of catalog_graph_export_runs. Then check that the Cloud Scheduler job catalog-graph-export exists and ran. A failed run changes nothing in BigQuery: the previous tables stay whole. Run it again by hand with: bash infra/catalog-graph-export.sh run
